app.title: Large Spreadsheet Analyzer
language.label: Language
step.file.title: Choose file
step.file.help: Select the spreadsheet you want to analyze. Supported formats: CSV, XLS, XLSX and ODS. Files of several hundred MB are fine.
step.import.title: Import options
step.import.help: Check how the file will be read. For CSV files, verify the separator, encoding and header settings with the preview.
step.rules.title: Define rules
step.rules.help: Each rule finds rows to fix, independently of the other rules. Add conditions and combine them with AND / OR. You can save rules to a JSON file and load them again later.
step.run.title: Run
step.run.help: Start the scan. The file is read once and every rule is evaluated on each row. You can cancel at any time and keep partial results.
step.report.title: Report
step.report.help: Review the matches of each rule, page through sample rows, and export the results.
file.memory_warning: XLS and ODS files cannot be read row by row: the whole sheet is loaded into memory. Very large files may be slow or run out of memory - consider converting to CSV or XLSX first.
